description: The number-row tap keys: the key left of 1 and the two right of 0, each assignable to any catalogue action and swallowed when tapped alone. Their defaults live in the features manifest (shortcuts.tap_keys.<id>). `ahk` is the AutoHotkey scancode, `hs` contains the ANSI virtual keycode followed by an optional ISO override; select one using the event keyboard model, never claim both codes. Karabiner ANSI virtual events use the ANSI position. Without an originating event the menu uses a localized physical position for the swapped pair. `linux` is the evdev keycode. Pinned to the Windows hotkeys by tools/test/test-tap-keys-single-source.cjs.
